decisions.reason: Step 1.1 did not specify the parameter sigma-algebra: Tonelli on completed Lebesgue space yields only Lebesgue measurability. This is a nonfatal omitted choice of measurable space, not a false conclusion. Repaired the proof using Lebesgue measure restricted to the Borel sigma-algebra and the equality of Euclidean product Borel and product sigma-algebras; Tonelli now gives Borel measurability pointwise, including infinite values. Positivity, the finite logarithm, singular covariance and the zero-covariance identity remain valid.
